description: This file provides Polish localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, including messages for loading results, input validation, and selection limits.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting to remove excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting to provide more input when input length is below minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
